name: Stockholm Bromma Airport

runway.v: one runway, 12/30, 1,668 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: open Monday-Friday 0600-2100, Saturday 0800-1600, Sunday 1100-2100 (UTC, winter; one hour earlier in summer), i.e. 07:00-22:00, 09:00-17:00 and 12:00-22:00 local

curfew.v: closed outside opening hours: on weekdays closed 22:00-07:00 local; on Saturday open only 09:00-17:00 and on Sunday 12:00-22:00 local
curfew.quote: STOCKHOLM/Bromma AD may be used only:

slots.v: a slot is required for every arrival and departure; for general aviation it can be requested at the earliest 28 days ahead and at the latest when the flight plan is filed
slots.quote: For GA traffic request of SLOT can be made earliest 28 days before estimated departure or arrival

handling.v: a ground handling company must be contracted for all flights, except aircraft granted PPR
handling.quote: Contracting a ground handling company is mandatory for all flights to and from STOCKHOLM/Bromma aerodrome, with the exception of aircraft granted PPR (Prior Permission Required).

ppr.v: PPR may be granted only for non-scheduled flights with MTOM up to 4,000 kg (or small helicopters)
ppr.quote: Prior permission may be granted (PPR) for non-scheduled flights with MTOM max 4000 kg or helicopters max D.13 m.

max_aircraft.v: aircraft with a reference code letter above C need permission from aircraft stand parking
max_aircraft.quote: Operators wishing to operate the airport with an aircraft with a higher reference code letter than C shall apply for permission to Aircraft Stand Parking

noise.v: noise emission must not exceed 89 EPNdB (average of three measuring points)
noise.quote: The noise emission must not exceed 89 EPNdB, an average for the three points of measurement

notes: AD 2.3 says AD operator hours 'Ref AIP SUP/NOTAM': check NOTAMs for temporary changes. Opening hours are given as UTC with summer times in brackets (assumed per Swedish AIP convention; GEN 2.1 not quoted), so local times are the same year-round. Weekend windows are narrower than the weekday curfew window recorded. AIP: LFV AIRAC AIP AMDT 3-2026 package (14 May 2026), ESSB pages dated 22 Jan 2026 (AMDT 1/2026); a later amendment may be in force. Bromma is a short runway: large-cabin jets may not be suitable.
